title: Alt + Space Windows Menu disable not working
author: kashkosh
summary: Alt+Space opens an unidentified Windows/PowerToys surface, but the reporter never completed the requested test with PowerToys Run disabled or its shortcut changed.

confidence.rationale: The maintainer already identified the exact unanswered isolation test.

judgment.rationale: The maintainer's original discriminator remains unanswered, the screenshot sent by email is unavailable, and the 0.75.1 report has no current confirmation.
evidence: A maintainer asked whether disabling PowerToys Run or changing its activation shortcut changes the behavior.
The reporter said they had not yet tried disabling or uninstalling PowerToys.
The attempted screenshot was sent by email and is not visible in the GitHub issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the still-missing PowerToys Run isolation test, a web-uploaded screenshot, and current-version confirmation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The existing report does not yet establish that a PowerToys defect remains after isolating PowerToys Run configuration.

issue_context.summary: Alt+Space opens an unidentified Windows/PowerToys surface, but the reporter never completed the requested test with PowerToys Run disabled or its shortcut changed.
known_information: The report used PowerToys 0.75.1 from the Microsoft Store and ran elevated.
Alt+Space is the default PowerToys Run shortcut unless changed.
Issue 39720 describes a similar but also ambiguous Alt+Space disable failure.
inferences: The reported surface may simply be PowerToys Run, but the unavailable screenshot and missing isolation test prevent confirmation.
issue_context.analysis: The exact maintainer question from 2023 still separates configuration behavior from a Keyboard Manager defect. It should be answered before any fix is designed.
initial_investigation: Read the complete body and all five comments.
Verified that the email attachment is absent from the public thread and the requested disable/reassign test was never reported.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Disable PowerToys Run or change its activation shortcut, then repeat Alt+Space in Notepad.

information_gaps.information: A visible screenshot of the opened surface.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Upload the image through the GitHub web UI rather than replying by email.

information_gaps.information: Whether the behavior reproduces on the current stable release.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest and provide the version shown in PowerToys About.

actions.label: Confirm the PowerToys Run isolation test

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming that Alt+Space opens an unwanted surface. The key isolation test requested earlier is still missing, and the emailed screenshot is not visible on GitHub. Please.

1. Retest on the current stable PowerToys release.
2. Disable PowerToys Run or assign it a different activation shortcut, then press Alt+Space in Notepad.
3. Upload a screenshot of the surface through the GitHub web UI and state whether it still appears.

This will determine whether the behavior is PowerToys Run configuration, the Windows system menu, or a Keyboard Manager interception defect.
